notes: ncu counters unavailable (ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM needs host NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdminUsers=0): timing-only run, analytic bytes, counters_ok=false [ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM]
fit and split use analytic bytes where ncu bytes are missing (see fit.bytes_source)
ncu dram_bytes_per_token counts reads only; split has the spec 2x state, split_read_only has 1x
ncu is kernel replay; rows with ncu_l2_state_ok false ran more than one pass on a warmed L2 (--cache-control none): dram bytes may be under-reported
static cache is read in full every step, so KV bytes scale with cache_len not ctx
reduce-overhead can skip CUDA graphs silently (mutated inputs); compare us/token with the other modes

gdn_impl=torch_fallback: GatedDeltaNet runs HF torch ops (several state-sized fp32 temporaries per layer per token), not a fused fla kernel; fit.floor_us_per_layer and fit.eff_bw_gbps describe that path, so proj_hybrid built on them is not representative of a fused implementation
ncu counts kernel nodes only; any cudaMemcpy node (e.g. a same-dtype copy_ into the cache) is excluded from dram_bytes_per_token
